home_chart_title: Categories added in the last 30 days
dash_story: Sample story: Üç Zeytin is a fictional restaurant with three branches in Kadıköy, Beşiktaş and Alsancak. All figures are mock data for January-October 2026; amounts are in thousand ₺ unless stated otherwise.
dash_turkey_note: All 81 provinces with real borders: color is tons supplied, lines are shipments to branches. Zoom with the wheel.
dash_race_note: Plays by itself: the ranking changes month by month. Jump to a month on the timeline below.
dash_step_note: Step line: flat until the price changes.
dash_share_area_note: Each month totals 100%; the shaded area is the summer season.
dash_share_bar_note: Kadıköy leads online orders, Beşiktaş leads dine-in.
dash_rose_note: Slice length shows sales. Patterns help readers who cannot tell colors apart.
dash_nested_note: Inner ring is the category, outer ring the dish; the legend scrolls.
dash_bubble_note: Third dimension is bubble size: revenue. Click the bands on top to filter.
dash_force_note: Drag nodes and zoom with the wheel; the small map in the corner shows your position.
dash_matrix_note: Matrix coordinate system: rows are branches, columns are categories.
dash_brush_note: Use the tools at the top right to select points, zoom or save an image.
dash_transform_note: Filtering and sorting use ECharts dataset transform; the text behind is the graphic component.
dash_liquid_note: Liquid fill: waves rise to the occupancy rate.
dash_words_note: Text size shows how often a word appears.
dash_bar3d_note: Rotate with the mouse, zoom with the wheel.
dash_line3d_note: Each branch runs on its own plane.
dash_scatter3d_note: Units sold, margin and total contribution.
dash_surface_note: Order forecast by price and weather temperature.
dash_map3d_note: Raised provinces are suppliers; height is tons.
dash_globe_note: Coffee, tea and spices flow to Istanbul on a spinning globe. No country borders: that needs world map data.
dash_lines_gl_note: Drawn with WebGL: smooth even with thousands of lines.
dash_scatter_gl_note: Each point is a ticket: lunch and dinner clusters separate.
dash_graph_gl_note: 400 customers linked to 13 dishes; the layout is computed live.
dash_flow_gl_note: Vector field: particles follow the direction of the ventilation.
dash_revenue_trend_note: Ahead of last year; above target from May onwards.
dash_channel_mix_note: Dine-in carries the business; catering rises with summer weddings.
dash_payments_note: More than half of the tickets are paid by credit card.
dash_occupancy_note: Average of the three branches; 68% on the same day last year.
dash_daily_note: Each weekend wave comes from dine-in.
dash_calendar_note: Each cell is a day: dark rows are weekends, dark months are the summer season.
dash_peak_hours_note: Friday to Sunday around 20:00 is the busiest slot; shifts follow it.
dash_hourly_note: A 24-hour dial with two peaks: lunch and dinner.
dash_river_note: Drinks swell in summer, soup retreats to winter.
dash_menu_tree_note: Area shows revenue: main courses make up nearly half.
dash_top_dishes_note: Kuzu Tandır and Adana Kebap stand out.
dash_engineering_note: The top right holds the stars: popular and profitable.
dash_profile_note: Each line is a dish: five measures from price to units sold.
dash_basket_note: Main courses share a ticket with drinks most often.
dash_tea_title: Tea by day of the week
dash_tea_note: Weekend sales are nearly double the weekdays.
dash_floor_note: Color is the revenue of the zone; lines are the flow out of the kitchen.
dash_prep_note: Takeaway has both the highest median and the longest wait.
dash_shifts_note: Blue is morning, orange is evening; handover runs 16:00-18:00.
dash_funnel_note: The biggest drop is between viewing the menu and adding to cart.
dash_scores_note: Customer survey: Alsancak is quick and good value, Kadıköy leads on taste.
dash_org_note: The three branch managers report to operations.
dash_recipes_note: Shows which dishes are affected if the lamb price moves.
dash_flow_note: How channel revenue splits into expenses, tax and net profit.
dash_waterfall_note: The two largest items are ingredients and staff.
dash_expenses_note: Inner ring is the expense group, outer ring the item.
dash_budget_note: Right is under budget, left is over: food is over budget.
dash_cash_note: The dashed line is the forecast for the next two months.
dash_lamb_note: Weekly candlesticks: red is a rise, blue a fall. Zoom with the wheel.
